label: anaerobic ammonium oxidation
definition: An anaerobic nitrogen metabolism in which ammonium is oxidized with nitrite as the electron acceptor to form dinitrogen.
observations: Ammonium-plus-nitrite anaerobic nitrogen metabolism; absent from live METPO except for obsolete METPO:1000812 Anaerobic ammonium oxidation and obsolete METPO:1002010 Anaerobic ammonium-oxidizing, and distinct from denitrification, DNRA, nitrification, and complete ammonia oxidation.
